name: SEXPOOL
source: Vicky - A patrol officer is trying to break up a local gang party. But something went wrong... There, she is undressed and made a sex slave all night. Vicky miraculously survives, but she has multiple injuries to her internal organs and has some fractures. In the hospital, she is invited to become a member of a secret government experiment that can return her to a full life.​
